Supplies a RouterAdapter to clicky-ui nav surfaces (AppSidebar, EntityExplorerApp, …). Hosts build the adapter from their own router (see useBrowserRouter / useMemoryRouter, or a react-router adapter).

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/rpc/RouterProvider.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { RouterProvider } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/rpc";
```
